quests.title: First Light
quests.description: Help Stella diagnose and power her repaired electrical relic.

quests.title: String Them Together
quests.description: Help Stella connect the circuit relics.

quests.title: Out of Alignment
quests.description: Finish Cinna Cirra’s Vis lesson, lift the orientation relic beside the C02 terrace and carry it through the ice-trial portal on the campus path at (47,45). Set it on the empty stand inside, then return to Cinna on the terrace.

quests.title: Cold Feet, Warm Idea
quests.description: Enter Cinna Cirra’s ice trial through the portal on the campus path at (47,45) and finish their Glaciate lesson. Freeze the pool at the relic you set on its stand, slide onto all twelve switches until every one is lit, then slide into the seal in the east wall. Glaciate is yours to keep once the seal opens.

quests.title: Patch Notes
quests.description: Finish Orio's Rotara lesson, then rotate the westForest F04 gear clockwise from 180 to the 90-degree notch and return to Orio.

quests.title: Something Borrowed
quests.description: Finish Katrina's Lost Echoes lesson, enter the garden recess through the portal east of the fountain, beside the B04 entrance, reveal her keepsake somewhere inside, then return it to her on campus. Lost Echoes is yours to keep once the keepsake is returned.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Looks like you found the keepsake. You take it with you. You should return it to Katrina.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: You came at the right time. My relic should store a charge and pass it on, but the prototype is refusing to cooperate.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: The five power relics are spread around the hall like the points of a star. Stand near one and press F; each switch changes several lights. Leave all five glowing together.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Visit each star-point relic and press F nearby. A switch can change more than one light, and the test completes only when all five glow together.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: All five relics are glowing and the power circuit is stable. I had planned every measurement, yet the answer was to test it with another person beside me.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: I opened a return portal beside us. It will take you back to the Campus entrance that leads toward B02.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: The first relic survived my repairs. The next board is worse: every special circuit relic must reach the right partner, and my plan is… technically elegant but not yet working.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: I will teach you Weave now. The five board relics have gone dark, and Ampere cannot wake them: they only take power through a cable. Power my relic at the workbench with Ampere, then cast Weave on it to hold a thread and cast again on a relay or relic within four tiles to tie it. Keep weaving, relay by relay, until all five relics glow. Finish this lesson to learn Weave.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Here is the Weave lesson again. Power my workbench relic with Ampere. Cast Weave on a relic to hold a thread, then on the next relay or relic within four tiles to tie a cable; the thread stays in your hand so you can carry on. Weave a linked pair again to cut it. A relic only lights while its cables lead back to my powered relic.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: All five relics are lit and the circuit holds its charge. I accepted help before rebuilding the whole board, which may be the most useful result of this assignment.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: I registered for orientation duty because it sounded welcoming. It is apparently for students who already know how half these objects work.

choices.text: The relic is on the trial stand.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: One of the orientation relics belongs in the ice trial, and it is far too heavy for me. Let me teach you Vis. Finish this lesson, then stand beside the relic and cast Vis to lift it. Carry it through the trial portal on the campus path at (47,45) and set it on the empty stand inside. You can only put it down on open ground, and if you wander into a building it settles back where you last left it.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: Lift the relic beside me with Vis, carry it through the trial portal on the campus path at (47,45), then face the empty stand inside and cast Vis again to set it down. If you lose track of it, press R near it on the terrace to bring it back. Come and tell me once it is on the stand.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: It is on the stand already? Then the trial can finally open. I will go ahead and get it ready. Meet me at the ice trial, through the portal on the campus path.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: The relic is on its stand and the trial is ready. I thought preparation meant knowing everything already, but asking for help taught me more quickly.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: Every switch lit and the seal answered. You read the ice instead of guessing at it, so Glaciate is yours to keep.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: This is the last orientation trial: twelve switches set into a pool, and a seal in the east wall that opens only when every switch is lit. I would prefer not to discover the wrong route with my feet.

choices.text: Let’s find a safe way through.
What do we know so far?

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: Then I will lend you Glaciate for the trial. Cast it on the relic you carried in, on its stand beside the pool, and the water freezes solid. On ice you slide until you land on a switch, reach the entrance or stop against a wall, so you cannot turn halfway. Landing on a switch lights it and landing on it again dims it. Light all twelve, then slide into the seal. If the count goes wrong, press R and the switches reset.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: Twelve switches and one seal. You only stop on a switch, at the entrance or against a wall, and every landing flips the switch beneath you. Follow the lines between the switches, and press R to reset if the count goes wrong. Cast Glaciate on the relic again if you want the pool back to water.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: The seal opened and you came through dry. Cold feet became a warm idea once we watched each slide instead of treating the pool as a dare. Glaciate is yours to keep.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: Welcome to the mechanism glade. I’m one turn away from a perfect optimisation, which is exactly why I’m not touching it again until the sequence is right.

choices.text: The dial is on the marked quarter turn.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: Rotara turns this gear clockwise by 90 degrees. Finish this lesson to learn the spell, then choose Rotara on the spell wheel and cast while standing near the F04 gear in westForest. Its dial starts at 180 degrees; three casts reach the teal 90-degree notch. Return to me when the pointer meets it.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: Finish this reminder to learn Rotara if you left the lesson early. Select Rotara on the spell wheel and cast near the F04 forest gear. Each cast adds 90 degrees clockwise: 180, 270, 0, 90. If you overshoot, keep turning until the pointer reaches the teal 90-degree notch, then report back.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: The forest gear is at 90 degrees and the pointer meets the notch. Patch confirmed. You used Rotara to reach the intended quarter turn.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: The mechanism is at the intended quarter turn and the sequence finally behaves. Practical checks beat rebuilding the whole solution in my head, so I may call that a successful patch.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: I’m looking for something. It is hardly a crisis, so please don’t make that face. I can replace it if I must.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: I can lend you Lost Echoes while you search. Finish this lesson, then search the garden recess. Its portal shimmers on the commons east of the fountain, right beside the B04 entrance. Stand within two cells and cast: it reveals a nearby hidden point. If you find no trace, move closer and try again. Bring the keepsake back to me and the spell is yours to keep.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: It is somewhere in the garden recess. The portal shimmers east of the fountain, right beside the B04 entrance. Lost Echoes reaches two cells along the grid, so move closer if there is no trace. Bring it back to me once you have it.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: That is it. Thank you for searching so carefully; I can stop pretending it was replaceable. Keep Lost Echoes. You have earned it.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: The keepsake is back with me, and I can stop pretending it was replaceable. It carries a history that no shop could restore, so thank you for searching carefully.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: The fountain makes the whole commons feel like a meeting point, even when everyone is hurrying to class.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: I keep forgetting which building has the practice hall. The signs are clear; my memory is not.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: Orientation looks much calmer from a bench with a snack.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: The lantern trail is easy to follow in daylight. At dusk, every tree starts looking like a landmark.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: The forest threshold is close enough to campus that I can practise a spell and still hear the gate bell.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: If you find the brook overlook, listen before you cast. The quiet is part of the place.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: Someone moved the cushions again. I respect the commitment to rearranging the common room every afternoon.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: The quickest route to a study group is usually following whoever is carrying three books and a snack.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: I heard a Spellio match decided by one tiny turn. Games here are apparently serious research.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: The commons is the only place where every route across campus seems to cross at once.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: The orientation terrace is busy today. I hope someone remembered the schedule.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: Lanterns make the forest trail look welcoming, even when the woods are being dramatic.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: I saw a new trail marker near the clearing. Or perhaps I saw the old one from a different angle.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: The common room is quiet for almost five minutes after breakfast. It is a remarkable campus record.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: A good study plan includes a break, a second break, and finding out what everyone else is playing.

Fired when Cinna leaves for the ice trial, after the orientation relic is on its stand and the player has reported back.
Puzzle callback after every ice-trial switch is lit and the seal in the east wall opens.
Puzzle callback after Orio's mechanism reaches its intended configuration.
Puzzle callback when Lost Echoes reveals Katrina's keepsake; the player carries it back to her.
Completion when the player returns Katrina's keepsake to her.
